title: All About My Two Dads
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Nao and Ai, a couple since university, marry when same-sex marriage becomes legal in Japan and adopt a newborn, Hiro. The slice-of-life series follows the two very different fathers through sleepless nights, preschool, other parents and Hiro's childhood, as parenting teaches them about themselves.
life_message: A loving, communicative family can be built by any two committed parents.

content.note: Married adult gay couple; affection, no sexual scenes noted (MU Shounen Ai, Wholesome; AniList review).
Fathers work through feelings by communicating (review).

dominant: Family and parenthood; same-sex marriage; communication and acceptance
